# Rights Statement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RightsStatement>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

A reified, machine-readable statement of the rights situation of an entity — an observation in the universal claim stack. Who may do what with it, under what licence, with what copyright, attributed to whom, over what term. The canonical superset of an ODRL Policy / Set: it bears [`gmeow:Permission`](gmeow-Permission.md), [`gmeow:Prohibition`](gmeow-Prohibition.md) and [`gmeow:Duty`](gmeow-Duty.md) rules and points at the asset it governs via [`gmeow:statementAbout`](../properties/gmeow-statementAbout.md) (the [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md)). Promote a flat [`gmeow:hasLicense`](../properties/gmeow-hasLicense.md) / [`gmeow:hasCopyright`](../properties/gmeow-hasCopyright.md) to a [`RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md) only when the deontic rules are needed.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
